parsed.explanation: The dossier documents active, current (2024–25) state-directed targeting: 84 arrests of mainly gay men and transgender women on indecency/morality charges across four cities, mass convictions of up to 4.5 years upheld on appeal, beatings, forced anal examinations used as evidence, and police abuse. Article 226 is actively applied to gender expression; cross-dressing is not expressly illegal but trans women are repeatedly prosecuted under it. Detention processing under birth names/gender is documented as systemic (Nov 2024). This is tier-2 organised state targeting — recurring arrests for identity/presentation, torture in custody, no relief — comparable to the 0.15–0.25 anchors (e.g., 0.15-C's raids and birth-sex cells, 0.25-A's raids and extortion). No evidence of execution or a capital regime, and enforcement appears targeted at visible/flagged persons rather than near-automatic for all trans visitors. Recourse has failed: pledges against forced testing were ignored by courts. Extrapolating from the criminalisation regime, active sweeps, custody abuse and absent protections resolves toward the high end of the high-risk band.
